note: Both sets share the same 14 claims, all faithful to the page text with supporting quotes. Set A adds one further correct claim — the CCD's delta doping and thickened substrate modification — which Set B omits. Neither set contains misread or invented values, so A is better only by that one additional correct fact.
remarks: Both sets label the UV channel as 'guide channel' (for its instrumentation and optical path claims). The text says the UV channel carries the low-resolution spectrometer and 'is also used as the guide channel for IR science', so the binding is defensible but slightly imprecise; naming it the Ultraviolet Channel would be clearer. Other facts on the page both sets leave out include the 4k-square spectral image area read into frame stores at high EMCCD gain and the thruster-firing readout requirement.
